# Toastmasters Aachen e. V.

Toastmasters Aachen e. V. is a bilingual (German/English) non-profit public speaking and leadership club based in Aachen, Germany. Part of the global Toastmasters International network, the club helps members improve their public speaking, presentation, and leadership skills in a supportive and friendly environment.

## Key Information
- **Domain**: https://aachen-toastmasters.de
- **Contact Email**: info@aachen-toastmasters.de
- **Meeting Location**: Digital Church Aachen, Jülicher Straße 72a, 52070 Aachen (Germany)
- **Meeting Schedule**: Every Tuesday at 7:00 PM (19:00). Alternating weekly between German and English.
- **Guests Policy**: Guests are warmly welcome to attend any meeting for free (CTA: "Komm einfach vorbei!"). No registration required.

## Club Concept & Offerings
- **Public Speaking Training**: Guided paths (Pathways) covering presentation design, vocal variety, body language, and storytelling.
- **Impromptu Speaking (Table Topics)**: Practice speaking spontaneously without preparation.
- **Constructive Evaluation**: Every speech receives constructive, structured feedback to foster personal growth.
- **Zweisprachigkeit**: German and English alternating weekly, making the club highly accessible to students (RWTH, FH), international researchers, and professionals in the Städeregion Aachen.
